synthesizedSquares.method: The pinned CC-1203 was loaded with pdf-lib, every page's /Annots and the catalog's /AcroForm were deleted, and the bare form was rastered at 300 dpi alongside the delivered fixture with the same flags, so no appearance a viewer might synthesize on either side can hide the defect. synthesizedSquares.method: The pinned CC-1201 was loaded with pdf-lib, every page's /Annots and the catalog's /AcroForm were deleted, and the bare form was rastered at 300 dpi alongside the delivered fixture with the same flags, so no appearance a viewer might synthesize on either side can hide the defect. For every unmarked selection widget the field map declares (disposition explicit_refusal, rect read first-hand from the pinned binary) the widget rect was windowed with a 2 px pad and pixels dark in the delivered page and not dark in the bare form were counted.
synthesizedSquares.sensitivity: The same measurement returns 56 of 56 on the pre-repair host family and 0 of 57 on va_seal_petition_felony-set, which is the live control that it sees the square when it is there and does not invent one when it is not.

This lane's own measurement of the same defect VF04 reported as 8945 px against declared boxes; the two numbers count different regions and agree on 56 of 56.
synthesizedSquares.after: 0 of 56 unmarked selection widgets carry added ink, in both fixtures, 0 added pixels.

inkAgainstDeclaredBoxes.method: Every page of both fixtures rastered at 300 dpi. On the composed pages all ink was tested against the 72-540.24 pt column.
